newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Man dies in Prague discotheque blaze.
newsitem.headline: Man dies in Prague discotheque blaze.

text.p: One man died and 18 people were injured when fire engulfed a Prague discotheque late on Tuesday, a police spokeswoman said on Wednesday.

A passing motorist alerted the fire brigrade when he spotted the fire at 9.35 pm (1935 GMT) on Tuesday at the up-market Safari Club in Prague's Smichov district, police spokeswoman Sona Jindrakova told Reuters.
police did not yet know the cause of the blaze.
The dead man had not yet been identified, while two of the injured had serious burns.
Firemen evacuated 28 people and the blaze was put out in just under an hour.
